Dattatreya Subramanya Vellal (Datta)
dsvellal@gmail.com | https://www.dsvellal.com
Software Competency Lead | LinkedIn: dattatreyavellal
Philips North America LLC

Datta has 15 years of experience in strategy & execution, software reliability & excellence, people leadership & culture, technical engagement & collaboration, software design & execution. Known for technical expertise, program management, human relation skills, problem solving, creating impact to individuals & organizations and trainings & knowledge development. Brings expertise to influence and solve complex challenges & create sustainable solutions & processes. Results-oriented individual, proactive in driving techno-functional engagements, handling uncertainties & mitigating concerns.

=== SKILLS ===
- Program management, Risk assessment, delivery
- Software architecture, design, development
- Teaching, communication, learning, influencing
- Handling business, technical and human concerns
- Expertise in programming languages, operating systems, infrastructure & technology stacks

=== EXPERIENCE ===

Software CoE Competency Lead | Philips North America LLC | Nov 2021 – Present
- Accountable for the Digital Transformation programs across USA, LATAM, Europe & Mexico. Pioneered global programs, set KPIs and Objectives, oversaw implementation. Reduced customer defects from 37 to 0.11 per 100 exams, improved ratings from 2.3 to 4.5 on app store.
- Responsible for creating global platforms to address developer experience, influencing more than 4500 GitHub philips-internal users globally in software security, reliability & quality.
- Lead continuous value delivery discussions with businesses. Strategize tasks, delegated responsibilities, oversaw execution of the program, reducing release time by 60%.
- Manage and grow a team of engineers. Responsible for their careers, yearly goals, and appraisals. As Philips global hiring bar-raiser, evaluate hiring process, coach the coaches, hire senior leaders.

Software Competency Lead | Philips India Limited | Sept 2018 – Nov 2021
- Lead coach for Software Center of Excellence program to achieve technical debt reduction and resource optimization. Realized savings of 2.1 million euros in 2021 with a future opportunity of 3.45 million euros savings.
- Sponsored by Philips India head to enhance Philips hiring process. Led a cross-functional team from program planning, execution, and risk management to adoption and community growth of interview bar-raisers. Improved candidate NPS by 18% and manager NPS by 15%.
- Improved competency of 30 Quality & Regulatory officers in Philips by mentoring them on developmental practices, leading to 40% improvement in competence.
- Set up outsource development center of 450 engineers by preparing proposals, evaluating 5 different contractors, negotiating SOWs, and recommended contracts to be awarded.
- Demonstrated thought leadership in building a network of influence and becoming the trusted advisor for different businesses. Directly influenced over 1500 engineers via workshops & mentoring.
- Proposed, planned & led the adoption of quality-at-desk program to identify & eliminate technical debt within teams. Led to savings of 100K$ per year for a team.
- Established global DevOps policies & practices for secure software development and delivery. Mentored leaders & helped them in establishing DevOps policies for their teams.
- Proposed & oversaw implementation of proprietary software reliability analyzer. Drove adoption within 4 business groups which led to identification and reduction of 18000 lines of duplicate code.
- Strategized roadmaps, oversaw execution, confirming progress on monitoring & measurement of processes in compliance with ISO 13485 and ISO14971 proactive risk control measures.

Software Development Engineer 2 | Amazon Development Center India Pvt Ltd | Feb 2016 – Aug 2018
- Accountable for building microservices, APIs, tools & platforms for retail and risk management systems.
- Implemented microservices, handled scales upwards of 1000 transactions per second.
- Facilitated scrum & agile product ownership workshops for over 150 participants.
- Optimized software by running performance benchmarking tools and saving ~34000$ in costs.
- Rolled out agile practices & daily management policies leading to 18% yield increase.
- Authored knowledge sharing docs including troubleshooting, on-call & on-boarding guides.

Senior Lead Software Development | Exeter Software India Pvt Ltd | April 2013 – Nov 2015
- Implemented functionalities of the Patient protection and Affordable Care Act for Hawaii & Vermont.
- Responsible for release scoping across legal, functional, development and test teams.
- Responsible for implementation and delivery of the projects, artifacts & config management.
- Managed team of 20 engineers. Responsible for hiring, performance reviews, mentoring, and year-end appraisals.
- Successfully resolved critical customer situations leading to faster adoption of releases.

Software Engineer | IBM India Software Labs (ISL) Bangalore | July 2007 – March 2013
- Worked on web services, developed multiple eclipse-based plugins for IBM products.
- Coded solutions integrating IBM products to support natural resources industry.

=== AWARDS & CONVERSATION STARTERS ===
- 2 USPTO Patents.
- Philips PIC Annual Awards 2020 for building organization capabilities.
- Philips CTO Outstanding Technical Achievement Award 2021 for improving competency of quality and regulatory compliance officers and working with global cross-functional teams to establish the bar-raiser hiring process at Philips.
- Philips Graduate Development Program stream lead for software, data, and analytics stream. Mentored several graduates across Netherlands, Brazil, India and Germany.
- Multiple Philips Manager Recognition Awards [2021-02, 2020-06, 2020-01, 2019-07, 2019-05].
- 47 invited lectures, seminars & workshops globally, addressing about 2500 participants across 22 different academic institutions.
- Toastmasters international certified competent communicator, competent leader, and leadership advisor.
- Lifetime member of Computer Society of India, and board member of CSI Bangalore Chapter, 2017-18.
- Active member of Mentor Together, mentoring engineering graduates globally.
- Volunteered with local organizations to distribute books and uniforms to children in need.

=== EDUCATION ===
- 2010-11, Annamalai University, Chidambaram, TN — Master of Science, Yoga
- 2009-10, Annamalai University, Chidambaram, TN — Postgraduate diploma, Yoga
- 2003-2007, RVCE, Bangalore, Karnataka — Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science
- 2001-2003, NCJ, Bangalore, Karnataka — Pre-university, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology
- 2001, Vijaya High School, Bangalore, Karnataka — Karnataka state board, 10th Grade
